game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Passage, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the lantern post, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the total value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lantern post from glow-eyed lurkers in Collapsed Passage: keep the total meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: total drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
